summary: A committee report lists bills its members can introduce without promising that every member backs them.
realLife: A Montana legislative committee released ten proposals and distinguished the list from an endorsement by each participant.
inGame: study-reported supplies a finding and member positions. needs: distinct draft bills and recorded endorsements for each.

turns.what: The committee votes to endorse one draft as a body.
turns.pulledBy: A majority agrees on the text before the report is due.
turns.writesBack: The report identifies the endorsed draft.

turns.what: A member signs one proposal and asks to be left off the others.
turns.pulledBy: The drafts address separate questions on which the member has different positions.
turns.writesBack: The report credits the member only on the signed draft.
